en: An old black‑and‑white postcard showing a long, elegant spa or hotel building with verandas and glass canopies, set in a landscaped garden with palm trees. Behind it rises a steep rocky hill topped by a medieval hilltop castle. Mountains surround the valley. The card has printed and handwritten text in multiple languages (Italian and Czech) on the front, including a greeting and an address at the top, and dense handwritten correspondence at the bottom.
